title: LanceDB: The data layer for multimodal AI
gist: Bessemer is leading LanceDB's $57.5M Series B, betting that the open-source Lance format becomes the Parquet-equivalent storage primitive for multimodal AI data. Downloads are in the tens of millions per month (up 6x in a year), with frontier labs using it for pre-training and WorldLabs, Applied Intuition, ByteDance and Netflix using it for post-training and retrieval.

insights.claim: AI itself is accelerating multimodal data growth: robots and vehicles log sensor streams continuously and generative models produce billions of images and videos, so the pile of training data is growing faster than ever.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Demand for storage/curation infrastructure scales with AI output, not just AI training budgets.
insights.quote: That pile is growing faster than ever because AI itself is producing it.

insights.claim: Bessemer argues legacy data systems built for rows of numbers and text strain when curating, searching and streaming petabytes of multimodal data into training or inference, creating an opening for a new data layer.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Incumbent tabular/warehouse formats face displacement risk at the multimodal AI data layer.
insights.locator: All roads lead to the same

insights.claim: Bessemer sees the smartest companies beginning to own their intelligence by post-training open models on proprietary data, as open source wins the AI infrastructure layer.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Favors tooling sold to enterprises fine-tuning open models over pure closed-API dependence.
insights.quote: open source is winning the infrastructure layer, and the smartest companies are beginning to own their intelligence by post-training open models on proprietary data

insights.claim: Lance is an open-source file format, table format and catalog spec for multimodal data, positioned to do for AI what Parquet does for analytics tables under data warehouses; a single Lance table holds raw images/video with metadata, features and vectors.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Watch whether Lance becomes a de facto standard format; format standards create durable lock-in for the commercial vendor.
insights.locator: Lance is an open-source file format

insights.claim: Lance supports native vector search and SQL on the data and lets a team add a column of embeddings to a petabyte table without rewriting it.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Schema-evolution without rewrites is a concrete cost advantage vs. Parquet-based pipelines at petabyte scale.
insights.quote: a team can add a column of embeddings to a petabyte table without rewriting it
insights.locator: Lance is an open-source file format

insights.claim: LanceDB monetizes via LanceDB Enterprise, which adds distributed indexing, high-throughput ingestion, training data loaders and feature engineering, deployed in the customer's own cloud or on-prem.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Open-core plus BYOC/on-prem deployment model; aligns with data-sovereignty demands of labs and enterprises.
insights.locator: Lance is an open-source file format

insights.claim: Bessemer frames prior generations of data infrastructure as won by a community-trusted open-source project paired with a company that made it work at scale, and expects the AI generation to follow the same pattern.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Investor playbook: back the commercial steward of the winning open-source AI data format.
insights.quote: Most prior generations of data infrastructure have been won by an open-source project the community trusted, paired with a company that made it work at scale.
insights.locator: Most prior generations of data infrastructure

insights.claim: LanceDB is downloaded tens of millions of times each month, a 6x increase within a year.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Rapid bottom-up developer adoption is a leading indicator for enterprise conversion.
insights.quote: Users download LanceDB tens of millions of times each month, up 6x within a year
insights.locator: Users download LanceDB tens of millions

insights.claim: Some frontier AI labs use LanceDB for pre-training at scale, consolidating many separate systems and homegrown pipelines into a single Lance-based platform for petabyte-scale curation and feature generation.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Frontier-lab adoption validates the format at the most demanding scale; consolidation threatens point-solution data tools.
insights.locator: Users download LanceDB tens of millions

insights.claim: WorldLabs, Applied Intuition and ByteDance use LanceDB for post-training, and Netflix uses it for production retrieval and ML ops.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Named customers span world models, autonomy, consumer AI and media, indicating broad multimodal demand.
insights.locator: Users download LanceDB tens of millions

themes.theme: Series B deal and team bet

insights.claim: Bessemer is leading LanceDB's $57.5M Series B alongside Innovation Endeavors, with continued participation from CRV, Theory Ventures, Dimension, Swift Ventures and Y Combinator.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Marks institutional growth-stage conviction in AI data-infrastructure as a distinct category.
insights.locator: This is why Bessemer is leading

insights.claim: LanceDB CEO Chang She, a co-author of pandas, built training pipelines on Parquet at Tubi and concluded the format needed to be rebuilt from first principles; CTO Lei Xu worked on HDFS at Cloudera and ML infrastructure for Cruise's self-driving fleet.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: Founder pedigree in pandas/HDFS supports credibility of a format-level bet.

insights.claim: Bessemer calls LanceDB the most credible candidate to become the shared data primitive that frontier labs, robotics companies, enterprises and agents need to curate, version, search and serve multimodal data at scale.
insights.speaker: Bessemer Venture Partners
insights.so_what: If correct, LanceDB is a category-defining infra layer for multimodal AI; track competing formats and vector DBs.
insights.quote: LanceDB is the most credible candidate to be that primitive
insights.locator: Most prior generations of data infrastructure
